title.zh: 拨款2,000美元或其必要部分，用于完成从联合省Naguilian至本格特省碧瑶的马车道路测量工作的法案
title.en: AN ACT APPROPRIATING THE SUM OF TWO THOUSAND DOLLARS, OR SO MUCH THEREOF AS MAY BE NECESSARY, FOR THE COMPLETION OF THE SURVEY OF A WAGON ROAD FROM NAGUILIAN, IN THE PROVINCE OF LA UNION, TO BAGUIO, IN THE PROVINCE OF BENGUET.
title.orig: AN ACT APPROPRIATING THE SUM OF TWO THOUSAND DOLLARS, OR SO MUCH THEREOF AS MAY BE NECESSARY, FOR THE COMPLETION OF THE SURVEY OF A WAGON ROAD FROM NAGUILIAN, IN THE PROVINCE OF LA UNION, TO BAGUIO, IN THE PROVINCE OF BENGUET.
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp 2.000 đô la hoặc phần cần thiết để hoàn thành việc khảo sát đường xe ngựa từ Naguilian, tỉnh La Union, đến Baguio, tỉnh Benguet
title.th: กฎหมายจัดสรรเงิน 2,000 ดอลลาร์ หรือเท่าที่จำเป็น เพื่อดำเนินการสำรวจเส้นทางถนนสำหรับรถม้าจากนากีเลียน จังหวัดลาอูนิออน ไปยังบาเกียว จังหวัดเบงเกต ให้แล้วเสร็จ
title.id: Undang-undang yang mengalokasikan 2.000 dolar atau sebanyak yang diperlukan untuk menyelesaikan survei jalan gerobak dari Naguilian, Provinsi La Union, ke Baguio, Provinsi Benguet
title.ms: Akta memperuntukkan 2,000 dolar atau sebanyak yang diperlukan untuk menyiapkan ukur kaji jalan kereta kuda dari Naguilian, Wilayah La Union, ke Baguio, Wilayah Benguet

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

text.en:
The sum of two thousand dollars, or so much thereof as may be necessary, is hereby appropriated,
out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the completion of the survey of a
wagon road from Naguilian, in the Province of La Union, to Baguio, in the Province of Benguet, subject to
the restrictions and directions of sections two, three, and four of Act Numbered Seven hundred and ninety-

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, September 8, 1903.
